flora: Fern_undergrowth (dense, low-lying thickets of varied fronds)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; lush and verdant feel; fronds have a soft, leathery texture with rounded tips; high-fidelity rendering of the intricate, repeating patterns of the fern leaves without looking sharp.

visual_logic.composition: A sweeping ground-level view of a dense fern thicket. The fronds are layered and overlapping, creating a complex, textured carpet that extends into a misty, sun-dappled background.
visual_logic.ground: Damp, dark organic mudstone and shale fragments, partially obscured by the dense green growth and botanical detritus.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; bright, diffused light filtering through the overhead canopy, creating a warm, hazy glow and complex dappled shadows on the forest floor.
